task: P5.15 Addendum 45 item 3 / W81: SRP1 barrier-gap estimate, terminal ADMM solves, x0 vs n7 0.25/1.0, against Phase A bars (read-only, zero solves)
objective_convention: Q = certified gross_operational_cost (settlement-excluded, gross of salvage); gap figures are EUR of Q (block weight applied); value = Q(0) - Q(unit)

formulas.n_pairs: var_lb_only + 2 var_lb_ub + var_ub_only + ineq_lb_only + 2 ineq_lb_ub + ineq_ub_only (IPOPT problem-size lines of the solve) -- identical to W73 FORMULAS[tso_barrier_gap_estimate] and W74
formulas.terminal_admm_solve: solve number K + 1 (1-based) of the block log, K = evaluation_record.cycles_run; admitted layouts: A (post_certification None, n_solves == K + 1, cold == [1]) and B (post_certification present, n_solves == K + 2, cold == [1, K + 2], solve K + 2 = the hull polish, never read); cold iff the run's first ||curr_z_L||_inf == 1.0
formulas.g_primary_b: w_b x n_pairs x mu_last / obj_scale (EUR of Q) -- W73/W74 formula, on the terminal ADMM solve
formulas.g_upper_b: w_b x n_pairs x C_unscaled (C_unscaled = the solve's final unscaled Complementarity, IPOPT max-norm)
formulas.G_agent: sum of g_b over the agent's blocks (TSO 12, DSO 36); G_total = G_TSO + G_DSO
formulas.Delta_G: G(x0) - G(unit): estimated barrier contribution to value = Q(0) - Q(unit); positive = value overstated
formulas.R: |Delta G_total| / (bar(x0) + bar(unit)), bars = phase_a_tables.json T1 bar_eur (Addendum 44 ruling 6)
formulas.units_check: ratio_b = f_ipopt_final_unscaled(terminal solve) / base_unweighted_b; base_unweighted_b = sum of ['generation_cost', 'flexibility_cost_internal', 'load_curtailment_cost', 'res_curtailment_penalty', 'ess_usage_cost', 'detector_penalty_total'] (component_levels_terminal.json unweighted) + interface_settlement_unweighted (interface_settlement_detail_s31c.json); residual_b = f - base (EUR/rep. day; = effective_scale x AL terms + rounding). Hypothesis EUR/rep.day holds iff all |ratio - 1| <= 0.05 and median <= 0.01
formulas.central_path_ratio: C_scaled_final / mu_last (1 on the central path)
formulas.mu_floor_pred: min(tol, compl_inf_tol x obj_scale) / (barrier_tol_factor + 1), barrier_tol_factor = 10 (IPOPT default, not set in the options list); at_floor iff |mu_last / mu_floor_pred - 1| <= 1e-3; tol and compl_inf_tol from the options list printed immediately before the run (None if absent)
formulas.block_weight_crosscheck: w_b == shared_resources_planning._get_admm_block_weight(SimpleNamespace(years, days, discount_factor from SRP1.json), y, d) to 1e-9 relative, and == settlement_weighted / settlement_unweighted to 1e-9 relative

limitations: ORDER-OF-MAGNITUDE estimate of the interior-point barrier gap; NOT a measured change in Q (no re-solve is made).
Subproblems are nonconvex AC-OPF: n_pairs x mu is not a bound on f(x_mu) - f*, only its scale.

n_pairs x mu is the central-path complementarity SUM; the first-order primal offset involves only strictly active pairs (~ n_active x mu), so the primary figure over-states the primal offset; inactive pairs load the dual side.
The final iterate is not exactly on the central path (central_path_ratio reported); the upper variant brackets it.
The gap is on the whole solved subproblem objective (base incl. settlement transfer + effective_scale x AL terms), not attributed to Q's components.
Per-block estimate: the barrier offset's effect on the ADMM consensus point (hence on other blocks) is not captured.
ESSO blocks are outside Q (_get_operational_recourse_components sums TSO + DSO network blocks) and are not estimated.
Cells are Phase A (AA-on C3 configuration, spec v15); the post-Addendum-30 baseline (C2) cells are not examined.

verdict.rule: R = |Delta G_total| / bar_sum with the PRIMARY formula; bar_sum = bar(a0_c7:x0) + bar(a0_c7:n7_p0.25_e1.0) from phase_a_tables.json T1 (Addendum 44 ruling 6: the bar-sum is the operative test; sigma_Q provenance only). R < 1 -> SUB-RESOLUTION at SRP1: the estimated barrier-gap difference cannot by itself produce a determinate value difference, and the sub-resolution caveat applies at SRP1 as at 2x2. R >= 1 -> AT/ABOVE RESOLUTION at SRP1: the caveat does not suffice there and the gap difference is material to the SRP1 value. The upper-bound variant is reported beside R and does not change the verdict; if it crosses 1 while R < 1 that is reported as a qualification.
verdict.sigma_Q_note: sigma_Q (Phase A, 10-18k) is provenance only (Addendum 44 ruling 6) and is not used

P1_identification.statement: In both cells (and the a1a duplicate of the unit) every one of the 48 TSO/DSO network logs has n_solves == cycles_run + 1 (initialisation + one solve per ADMM cycle), solve #1 is the ONLY cold-multiplier solve, there is no hull-polish solve (post_certification is None), no recovery log exists, and 48 x (cycles_run + 1) + ESSO log count == solve_profile.permitted_solve

P2_units.statement: The terminal ADMM solve's final unscaled IPOPT objective is in EUR per representative day: for every block |f_ipopt / base_unweighted - 1| <= 0.05 and the median over blocks <= 0.01, where base_unweighted = the block's non-definitional unweighted components + unweighted interface settlement (the alternative, f in units of base / effective_scale, predicts a ratio ~ w_b / sigma ~ 5e-6)

P3_x0_TSO_level.statement: G_TSO(x0) = sum over the 12 TSO blocks of w_b x n_pairs x mu_last / obj_scale lies in [300, 5,000] EUR

P4_unit_TSO_scale.statement: The unit cell's TSO objective scaling factor is strictly lower than x0's in >= 9 of the 12 TSO blocks (the structural scaling mismatch found at 2x2 carries to SRP1)

P5_TSO_sign.statement: G_TSO(unit) < G_TSO(x0), i.e. the TSO gap difference x0 - unit is positive (as at 2x2)

P7_headline.statement: |Delta G_total| / (bar(x0) + bar(unit)) < 0.25, Delta G_total = G_total(x0) - G_total(unit), G_total = G_TSO + G_DSO (primary formula)

P8_upper_variant.statement: |Delta G_upper_total| / bar-sum < 1, G_upper = sum of w_b x n_pairs x (final unscaled complementarity, IPOPT max-norm) -- the looser bound

P9_duplicate.statement: The a1a duplicate unit evaluation's terminal-solve fields (obj_scale, mu_last, n_pairs, iterations, final unscaled objective, final unscaled complementarity) are identical to the a0_c7 unit's in all 48 blocks
